A [[Bith/Legends|'''Bith''']] [[Gender/Legends|male]] owned a refueling station on the bleak world of [[Orondia/Legends|Orondia]], a planet near [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. [[Unidentified Bith starship dealer|His brother]] sold a ship to the trio of bounty hunters [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], [[Moralo Eval/Legends|Moralo Eval]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], disguised as [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]]. He only put enough fuel in the ship to reach his [[Gender/Legends|brother's]] station on Orondia so they would both turn a profit. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] pursued the bounty hunters to Orondia and the [[Showdown on Orondia/Legends|Showdown on Orondia]] ensued.<ref name="Friends and Enemies" />
